_comment: The single list of canonical shared files (atrium-project#59). Every file under
docs/templates/shared/ that para-drift.reusable.yml holds byte-identical across
the five tool repos has exactly one row here. Adding a file to this directory
means adding one row here -- not editing scripts/revendor_shared.sh, tools/
skill_drift_check.py, para-drift.reusable.yml and docs/templates/ruff.toml by
hand in four places that used to drift independently. tests/test_shared_manifest.py
enforces that every file in this directory has a row, and every row has a file.
Fields:
canonical           filename under docs/templates/shared/ (the source of truth)
dest                path RELATIVE TO A TOOL REPO ROOT where the vendored copy lives
selftest            true if `python3 <dest> --selftest` is a meaningful check
(revendor_shared.sh's SELFTESTS array; para-drift.reusable.yml's
selftest steps) -- the module must support --selftest itself
ruff_format_exclude true if docs/templates/ruff.toml's [format] exclude (and each
tool repo's own copy of that list) must name `dest` -- i.e. this
is a .py file at all; the two .schema.json entries are not
isort_first_party   the module name for docs/templates/ruff.toml's
[lint.isort] known-first-party, or null if `dest` is not an
importable top-level module (a test file, a .schema.json)
preconditions       repo-relative paths this file's OWN tests need that are NOT
vendored alongside it (revendor_shared.sh's PRECONDITIONS map)
issue               the atrium-project issue this file's canonicalization landed
under, or null
note                a short reason for anything non-obvious about this entry, or null

files.note: not Python -- ruff format/isort do not apply
not Python -- ruff format/isort do not apply

sits at the repo root beside atrium_vocab.py, which it imports for concept URIs -- Python puts a script's own directory on sys.path, so --selftest resolves that import from the vendored copy with no PYTHONPATH, exactly as para-drift runs it
itself a pytest file, run by each repo's ordinary fast lane -- no separate --selftest step
imports a repo-local declaration module that cannot be vendored alongside it -- see PRECONDITIONS' consumer in scripts/revendor_shared.sh
pins the apt-get upgrade layer that keeps the release gate passable -- the perl-base CRITICALs that blocked translator v1.0.0-beta and nlp-enrich v0.20.2 published both by digest with no :latest tag

the schema exactly as the freeze tag doc-schema-v1 has it (git blob 1945c43e...) -- never edited, only re-vendored; it sits beside atrium_document.py like the live schema, and test_schema_freeze.py pins it by blob id. Not Python -- ruff format/isort do not apply

checks this repo's own vendored schema against the doc-schema-v1 frozen copy (blob pin, no removals, a register of every post-freeze change) -- stdlib only; the checks that need the tag, the changelog or jsonschema stay in the hub's tests/test_schema_freeze_records.py
